finding: A bare WebGPU canvas, an isolated Three.js cube, and the game all reported a destroyed device on canvas presentation.
resolution: Adding --use-angle=swiftshader preserved a healthy WebGPU device. The game also recovers automatically to WebGL 2 if the WebGPU device is lost.
capture: Healthy WebGPU state can still accompany blank headless screenshots. Layout captures use WebGL 2.
